label: rem:lqg-quantum-group-hyperbolic-observables-prior-art
title: Prior art: $U_q(\mathfrak{su}(2))$ spin networks carry hyperbolic geometric observables
html:
Dupuis and Girelli replace \mathrm{SU}(2) by U_q(\mathfrak{su}(2)) in loop quantum gravity and build length, area and angle operators from U_q(\mathfrak{su}(2)) tensor operators [dupuis-girelli2013, \S V, pp. 20--24]. In 3d Euclidean LQG with \Lambda < 0, a three-leg intertwiner then encodes the quantum state of a hyperbolic triangle: the angle operators quantise the hyperbolic cosine law, and the cosmological constant gives a minimum angle.

This is an independent instance of the step the comparison with canonical programmes relies on, that a q-deformation of the gauge structure produces hyperbolic geometric data. It does not reach hyperbolic volume: the paper constructs no volume operator for a hyperbolic polyhedron and leaves it as an open route [dupuis-girelli2013, concluding section, p. 24], so it gives no support to any volume-valued QOU quantity.
